description: Attach a file to a Pipedrive deal/person/organization (pass at least one of deal_id/person_id/org_id). Provide the file via `document_id` (preferred — an existing CallPilotAI document already stored on a lead/contact/account) or `source_url` (a remote URL fetched server-side). Do NOT pass raw file content — there's no base64 parameter; both supported sources avoid the calling model ever handling the file's bytes directly.
name: upload_pipedrive_file
